method.reason: PBE0 is an explicitly documented one-parameter hybrid functional (25% HF exchange) and is an allowed choice for this neutral closed-shell HCN task; it is inexpensive for three atoms while including exact-exchange admixture relevant to shielding. This fixes the wavefunction as RKS for the singlet. The citation identifies the documented functional; it is not scientific validation.

sources.quote: PBE0 [229] PBE0 25 One-parameter hybrid version of PBE

basis.reason: def2-TZVP is an allowed polarized valence triple-zeta basis; for a three-atom molecule the cost is modest under the four-core / 192 MB-per-process limits, and the larger flexible basis is preferable to def2-SVP for the anisotropic GIAO tensor and its isotropic trace. The citation establishes the documented basis label, not scientific validation.

sources.quote: def2-TZVP H–Rn def2-ECP (Rb–Rn) Polarized valence triple-\(\zeta\). Quite similar to the older def-TZVPP for main group elements and TZVP for H.
